mode: complementary 2T2MTJ bitcell digital CIM; exact integer arithmetic conditional on correct storage/sensing
kind: conditional engineering estimate; not a measured combined macro or BER guarantee

mapping.encoding_location: local 64-bit logical data expands to 128 physical P/AP target bits before shared physical interface
mapping.boundary_restore: covered by read-slot initialization and final control tick
mapping.required_resources: 64 native 256x4 IBMD banks; 4096 active local differential digitizers and before-adder tap/mux lanes; 4096-bit new single tile register and 4096 separate AND gates; 128 write paths with 25.6 mA aggregate SL rating; 64 additional single-ended absolute-state verify lanes, 128-bit state latch, 64 comparators and 128-bit target register.
mapping.bank_address: W[o,i] bit b -> bank=2*o+b//4, row=i, column=b%4
mapping.readout_isolation: Selected local IBMD OUT nodes tapped before original bank adder; 4096 lanes select eight row groups x two output groups through 16:1 muxes. Original summed four-column bank output is not treated as independently read weights.
mapping.hold_lifetime: Set IN=1 to sense selected W; capture one tile for one TD; isolate/reset IBMD while separate AND gates apply all eight true input bits. Tile replacement, verification and writing are mutually exclusive.
mapping.bank_write_isolation: Sixteen selected banks x one row x four complementary bits; per-bank row/SL gating and unselected high-Z isolation prevent writes to other banks. Reference resource, not implicit in interface width.

assumptions: main scenario completes and passes both-branch absolute-state verify within one full attempt
comparison completes and passes after exactly one whole-group rewrite; failed attempt time is retained
verify must be qualified at the chosen bias/load; exact arithmetic contract is conditional on correct storage and sensing
failure outside the finite budget is not counted as completed payload; no indefinite retry policy or success-probability guarantee is asserted
retry_model.payload_rule: only one successfully completed logical group counted; all internal writes/verifies/retries are occupancy

comparison.kind: conditional successful completion on second full attempt, not universal or prescribed retry count

stage_coverage.write_access: 20/30 ns engineering single-direction physical slots anchored to published full write access; cover drive initialization, pulse/switching/stop/recovery; published access has no portable substage decomposition
stage_coverage.verify_read: one complete low-bias single-ended branch sense/reset/mux slot; two branches separately; digital capture and compare each one TD after the read
stage_coverage.turn: one digital tick between two direction slots
stage_coverage.compare: one digital tick per 64-bit branch comparison; pair validity accumulated
stage_coverage.front: shared API front_ns physical encoded loading with first beat in command and two control ticks
stage_coverage.stream: read slot covers initialization/precharge, IN=1 differential digitization and before-adder tap/mux selection; one TD captures W and completes isolation handoff. Next-tile precharge is included in its read slot. Separate digital AND plus 32-term reduction uses one shared TD, not the original macro clock.

maintenance.condition: nondestructive qualified low-bias read; no retention-refresh claim outside service window
maintenance.endurance: separate feasibility constraint; two-phase complement refresh stresses cells unequally; no universal cycle rating imported

selection_rules.choice: native K256/N32 storage with common32-term/16-output activity and explicit weight capture/AND periphery
selection_rules.reason: The native64bank x256x4bit capacity maps exactly to32 INT8 outputs. Existing IBMD latch is IN AND W, so a separate capture path is needed for input-bit reuse.

selection_rules.choice: B_R=8 Byte and 128 physical target bits
selection_rules.reason: 64 complementary weight bits limited by explicitly provisioned 128 first-phase write paths

selection_rules.choice: complete write-access slot replaces its internal timing; only interphase control, independent two-branch verify and local interface added
selection_rules.reason: MRAM-03 full write access and MRAM-06 two-step write/row retry

scenario_interpretation.main_range: conditional paired short/reference/long engineering scenarios, not a physical uncertainty envelope
scenario_interpretation.linked: Each shared profile TD and its control/boundary terms must move together; media timing choices need not physically co-vary with the shared profile.
scenario_interpretation.maintenance_scope: No periodic maintenance in the modeled local service window; raw occupancy equals effective interval for the stated accepted service scenario.

logical_configuration.selection: MRAM-06 p.5 native 64 banks x 256 rows x four weight-bit columns; two banks per INT8 output, yielding W[32,256]. Native bank storage retained; common limited digital periphery replaces original full 256-term reduction.

driver_budget.evidence: MRAM-06 p.8 Methods / p.14 Extended Data Fig.1(b): measured quasi-static I-V is approximately within 180 uA magnitude across shown -0.6 to +0.6 V sweep; SI p.4 gives 512Iw/256Iw for 256 pairs.
driver_budget.scope: 200 uA/path is an explicit reference capacity condition, not measured 20/30 ns pulse current or a write-success bound. Selected pulse/bias/load must fit it; same installed rating across all main scenarios.

reported_evidence.adopted: native weight banks; original full 256-term digital organization replaced by declared common 32-term/16-output periphery

reported_evidence.original: OUT=IN AND W; read mode IN=1 makes OUT=W; original macro reads selected-row result through adder tree
reported_evidence.adopted: 4096 pre-adder taps plus tile capture, then separate AND; no inference that existing latch is input-independent W memory

reported_evidence.read_condition: 1.2 V, 25 C; finite error conditions retained
reported_evidence.limit: 1T1MTJ evidence; finite zero-error floor not transplanted as new implementation probability
